true_false_rapid_fire.statement: Real numbers include all rational and irrational numbers.
true_false_rapid_fire.explanation: Real numbers encompass all rational numbers (fractions) and irrational numbers (non-repeating, non-terminating decimals).

true_false_rapid_fire.statement: Linear equations have the highest power of the variable(s) as 2.
true_false_rapid_fire.explanation: Linear equations are defined as having the highest power of the variable(s) as 1, not 2.

true_false_rapid_fire.statement: The Indus Valley Civilization is considered one of the earliest urban civilizations in the world.
true_false_rapid_fire.explanation: Ancient India, specifically the Indus Valley Civilization, was a cradle of civilization with significant advancements in architecture, governance, and trade.
